findings: Regular art is currently fitted into the larger hidden MSE mask rectangle and overcropped. Fit the visible art aperture separately from the mask.
Use dedicated outlined Future mana discs, with the curved cost column, rather than ordinary modern glyphs.
Five textless creatures require the separate full-art frame and lower type bar. Their empty original text has been verified against exact scans.
Bound in Silence has a modern Kindred rename in its original type source. The scan-verified type is Tribal Enchantment — Rebel Aura.
Graven Cairns legacy hybrid notation must normalize before parsing reminders.
Ghostfire uses a clear frame: the Card Conjurer source contains partial alpha in the frame and paper. Audit the background art layer before fitting colors.
Two-color land panels and light text need their own source blend treatment. Dryad Arbor uses a green land/creature treatment.
Footer placement, brush marker, legal text and P/T remain uncalibrated.

Measured art-source issue: Aven Mindcensor and Ghostfire 540×448 art_crop files register into only about 353×293 canonical pixels at x≈105,y≈84, omitting the curved left portion of the printed window. Ghostfire also lacks full-height background art. Keep source mismatch separate from frame calibration; do not stretch the cropped art or fit renderer geometry to it.
